summary: Cognition released SWE-2.1, an upgrade over SWE-2 trained with reinforcement learning on Kimi K3. The launch post says the model is free through 12/8 on Devin Desktop and CLI, and available in Devin Desktop, Cloud and CLI at a discounted price until 1/30. The post does not state usage caps or which plans are eligible.
claim_steps: Sign in to Devin Desktop or the Devin CLI
Select the SWE-2.1 model before December 8

social_proof.title: Introducing SWE-2.1
social_proof.text: We're releasing SWE-2.1, a major upgrade over SWE-2. ... Free through 12/8 on Desktop and CLI. Available in Devin Desktop, Cloud, and CLI at a discounted price until 1/30.

social_proof.title: Devin Plans and Pricing
social_proof.text: The Free plan includes a light quota to code with agents, limited model availability, unlimited inline edits, and unlimited Tab completions.
